role: support-only low-level descriptor probe; no test image or test label

scope.support_selection: manifest seed0 k2; each query support image held out from memory

old_route_audit.old_mechanism: 2-level Haar robust residual on 448 map; gray + R-G + B-Y; real A1-missed-region diagnostic
old_route_audit.old_decision: FAIL_ARCHIVED; mean delta STR-A1 -0.027368; positive 1/6 categories
old_route_audit.overlap: both are raw image high-frequency/gradient evidence
old_route_audit.difference: this probe uses 1024-native 64-grid gray statistics, k2 support-derived 24 masks, global NN, memory-only scaling, raw/DINO controls
old_route_audit.novelty_boundary: engineering validation only; high-frequency/gradient representation itself is not claimed novel

input.raw_source: MPDD train/good support original images only
input.cache: outputs/dynamic_fusion/v14_p1_support (DINO clean/synthetic/nuisance features and mask parity)
input.mask_rule: R.render_synthetic with existing v14 _variant_seed; exact mask parity asserted when cache exists

descriptor.gray: RGB luminance 0.299 R + 0.587 G + 0.114 B, divided by 255
descriptor.photometric_mean_removal: subtract one image-wide grayscale mean before local statistics
descriptor.dino_full32: cached frozen DINO 32 x 32 x 768 descriptor; no raw re-encoding

normalization_and_score.memory_scale: per-dimension median/MAD estimated from the other clean support image cells only
normalization_and_score.score: global NN anomaly score = 1 - maximum cosine over the other clean support image
normalization_and_score.map: bilinear 64-grid or native 32-grid score map to 1024 x 1024

methods.dino_full32: single frozen DINO full-image descriptor control

evaluation.synthetic: original 1024 x 1024 renderer mask; Pixel-AP; thin_scratch and cutpaste only
evaluation.normal: cell-level ROC-AUC of clean query versus 15 photometric nuisance queries; 0.5 is stable
evaluation.normal_auxiliary: mean nuisance score minus mean clean score
evaluation.parameter_selection: none; all descriptor and normalization constants frozen before AP
